The 1910 date for the white-eye discovery (and thus the start of Drosophila chromosome genetics) is corroborated by Wikipedia. Britannica's '1909' refers to the year a series of mutants appeared, not the specific white-eye discovery. Harvest value 1910 is corroborated. Logging as corroborated with clarification.
